title: A reconstructed transition between effective models is Cartesian
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a singleton fpqc covering of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For each affine open $A$ of $S$, put $X_A=X\times_S A$ and $V_A=V\times_X X_A$, for a scheme $V\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $W_A\to A$ and $r_A:V_A\to W_A$ exhibit $V_A$ as $W_A\times_A X_A$. For an inclusion $i:U\hookrightarrow B$ of affine opens, let $c_i:V_U\to V_B$ be the canonical restriction map. If $t:W_U\to W_B$ satisfies $t\,p_B=p_U\,i$ and $r_U\,t=c_i\,r_B$, then the square with edges $t,p_U,p_B,i$ is Cartesian. No descent datum or invariance hypothesis is needed once the reconstruction equation is assumed.

proof.text: Let x : X_U → X_B and c : V_U → V_B be the canonical cover transitions. Their projection equations follow by unfolding Cover.trans on a pulled-back directed cover and pullback.map. Cancel the B defining pullback square from the U defining pullback square using IsPullback.of_right to get IsPullback c snd_U snd_B x. Paste it with hp B. The reconstruction equation hr and the second projection equation for x identify the resulting outer square with IsPullback (r U ≫ t) snd_U (W B).hom (q_U ≫ i).

The singleton q_U : X_U → U is fpqc by base change of hf, using Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback on the flipped canonical pullback square. Regard it as Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.singleton q_U hq. The fpqc topology is subcanonical by the cited representable-descent Mathlib leaf. Apply Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.isPullback_of_forall_isPullback to the flipped desired square, with this cover of U.

The criterion asks for the pullback square on pullback (W U).hom q_U. The given hp U supplies its canonical isomorphism from V_U. Transport the flipped outer square of Step 1 along (hp U).isoPullback using IsPullback.of_iso; its projection equations are isoPullback_hom_snd and isoPullback_hom_fst. All other objects have identity isomorphisms. This proves the local square, so the criterion proves the flipped desired square. Flip back and retain the given commutativity ht. No descent witnesses are chosen by this module.

lean.statement:
theorem fpqc_affine_model_transition_cartesian
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (hf : Presieve.singleton f ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage S)
    {V : Over X}
    (W : ∀ U : S.affineOpens, Over U.1.toScheme)
    (r : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
      pullback V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι) ⟶ (W U).left)
    (hp : ∀ U, IsPullback (r U) (pullback.snd V.hom (pullback.fst f U.1.ι))
      (W U).hom (pullback.snd f U.1.ι))
    {U B : S.affineOpens} (i : U ⟶ B)
    (t : (W U).left ⟶ (W B).left)
    (ht : t ≫ (W B).hom = (W U).hom ≫ S.directedAffineCover.trans i)
    (hr : Scheme.Cover.trans ((S.directedAffineCover.pullback₁ f).pullback₁ V.hom) i ≫
      r B = r U ≫ t) :
    IsPullback t (W U).hom (W B).hom (S.directedAffineCover.trans i)
